ch_vocab_b2_01.title: Politics & Government
ch_vocab_b2_01.theory:
## Political and Government Vocabulary

At the B2 level, you should be able to discuss political systems, elections, and government policies with confidence. Spanish-speaking countries have diverse political structures, and understanding this vocabulary is essential for reading newspapers, following debates, and expressing opinions on public affairs.

### Government Institutions
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **el gobierno** | government |
| **el parlamento / las Cortes** | parliament |
| **el Congreso de los Diputados** | Congress (Spain) |
| **el Senado** | Senate |
| **el tribunal** | court |
| **el Tribunal Supremo** | Supreme Court |
| **el ministerio** | ministry / department |
| **el ayuntamiento** | city hall / local council |

### Political Roles
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **el/la presidente/a** | president |
| **el/la primer/a ministro/a** | prime minister |
| **el/la diputado/a** | member of parliament |
| **el/la senador/a** | senator |
| **el/la alcalde/alcaldesa** | mayor |
| **el/la ministro/a** | minister / secretary |
| **el/la candidato/a** | candidate |

### Elections and Democracy
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **las elecciones** | elections |
| **votar** | to vote |
| **el voto** | vote |
| **la campaña electoral** | election campaign |
| **la urna** | ballot box |
| **el escaño** | parliamentary seat |
| **la mayoría absoluta** | absolute majority |
| **el referéndum** | referendum |

### Key Political Verbs and Expressions
- **aprobar una ley** — to pass a law
- **derogar una ley** — to repeal a law
- **gobernar** — to govern
- **dimitir** — to resign (from office)
- **convocar elecciones** — to call elections
- **presentar una moción de censura** — to file a motion of no confidence
- **estar en la oposición** — to be in the opposition

### Talking About Politics
- **El gobierno aprobó una reforma fiscal.** — The government passed a tax reform.
- **Se convocaron elecciones anticipadas.** — Early elections were called.
- **La oposición presentó una moción de censura.** — The opposition filed a motion of no confidence.
- **El partido ganó por mayoría absoluta.** — The party won with an absolute majority.
key_points: el gobierno = government, el parlamento = parliament, el ministerio = ministry
aprobar una ley = pass a law, derogar = repeal, convocar elecciones = call elections
votar = to vote, la campaña electoral = election campaign, el escaño = seat
dimitir = to resign from office, la oposición = the opposition
la moción de censura = motion of no confidence, el referéndum = referendum

vocab_list.example: El gobierno aprobó la nueva ley de educación.
vocab_list.example_meaning: The government approved the new education law.

vocab_list.example: Los ciudadanos votaron en las elecciones municipales.
vocab_list.example_meaning: The citizens voted in the municipal elections.

vocab_list.example: La campaña electoral duró tres meses.
vocab_list.example_meaning: The election campaign lasted three months.

vocab_list.example: El parlamento aprobó una ley contra la corrupción.
vocab_list.example_meaning: The parliament passed an anti-corruption law.

ch_vocab_b2_02.title: Philosophy & Thought
ch_vocab_b2_02.theory:
## Philosophy and Abstract Thought Vocabulary

Philosophy vocabulary allows you to engage in deeper, more abstract discussions. At the B2 level, being able to express ideas about ethics, logic, and belief systems sets you apart as an advanced communicator.

### Core Philosophical Terms
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **la filosofía** | philosophy |
| **la ética** | ethics |
| **la moral** | morality |
| **la lógica** | logic |
| **la razón** | reason |
| **la conciencia** | consciousness / conscience |
| **el pensamiento** | thought / thinking |
| **la existencia** | existence |
| **la verdad** | truth |
| **la libertad** | freedom |

### Schools of Thought
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **el racionalismo** | rationalism |
| **el empirismo** | empiricism |
| **el existencialismo** | existentialism |
| **el idealismo** | idealism |
| **el materialismo** | materialism |
| **el humanismo** | humanism |
| **el relativismo** | relativism |

### Abstract Reasoning Verbs
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **reflexionar (sobre)** | to reflect (on) |
| **cuestionar** | to question |
| **plantear** | to raise / pose (a question) |
| **suponer** | to suppose / assume |
| **deducir** | to deduce |
| **argumentar** | to argue (a point) |
| **concebir** | to conceive (an idea) |

### Useful Expressions
- **Desde el punto de vista ético...** — From an ethical standpoint...
- **Eso plantea una cuestión moral.** — That raises a moral question.
- **En teoría... pero en la práctica...** — In theory... but in practice...
- **Es una cuestión de principios.** — It is a matter of principles.
- **Hay que reflexionar sobre las consecuencias.** — One must reflect on the consequences.
- **La razón no siempre coincide con la emoción.** — Reason does not always align with emotion.
key_points: la ética = ethics, la moral = morality, la conciencia = consciousness/conscience
reflexionar = reflect, cuestionar = question, plantear = raise/pose, deducir = deduce
Key schools: racionalismo, empirismo, existencialismo, humanismo
Desde el punto de vista ético = from an ethical standpoint

vocab_list.example: La ética profesional es fundamental en la medicina.
vocab_list.example_meaning: Professional ethics are fundamental in medicine.

vocab_list.example: Es importante reflexionar sobre nuestras decisiones.
vocab_list.example_meaning: It is important to reflect on our decisions.

vocab_list.example: Actuó en contra de su conciencia.
vocab_list.example_meaning: He acted against his conscience.

vocab_list.example: El profesor planteó un dilema ético muy interesante.
vocab_list.example_meaning: The professor posed a very interesting ethical dilemma.

ch_vocab_b2_03.title: Literature & Criticism
ch_vocab_b2_03.theory:
## Literary and Critical Vocabulary

Discussing literature, writing styles, and literary criticism requires specialized vocabulary. At the B2 level, you should be able to analyze texts, describe narrative techniques, and express opinions about literary works.

### Literary Genres
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **la novela** | novel |
| **el cuento / el relato** | short story |
| **la poesía** | poetry |
| **el ensayo** | essay |
| **el teatro / la obra de teatro** | theater / play |
| **la fábula** | fable |
| **la biografía** | biography |
| **la ciencia ficción** | science fiction |

### Narrative Elements
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **el narrador** | narrator |
| **el personaje** | character |
| **el protagonista** | protagonist |
| **el antagonista** | antagonist |
| **la trama / el argumento** | plot |
| **el desenlace** | ending / resolution |
| **el clímax** | climax |
| **el escenario / el ambiente** | setting |
| **el punto de vista** | point of view |

### Literary Devices
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **la metáfora** | metaphor |
| **la ironía** | irony |
| **el simbolismo** | symbolism |
| **la alegoría** | allegory |
| **la hipérbole** | hyperbole |
| **el símil / la comparación** | simile |
| **la personificación** | personification |

### Critical Analysis Vocabulary
- **analizar** — to analyze
- **interpretar** — to interpret
- **la obra maestra** — masterpiece
- **la corriente literaria** — literary movement
- **el estilo narrativo** — narrative style
- **el trasfondo** — background / underlying theme
- **hacer una reseña** — to write a review

### Talking About Literature
- **La novela aborda el tema de la soledad.** — The novel addresses the theme of loneliness.
- **El autor emplea la ironía para criticar la sociedad.** — The author uses irony to criticize society.
- **El desenlace es inesperado.** — The ending is unexpected.
- **Es una obra maestra de la literatura hispanoamericana.** — It is a masterpiece of Latin American literature.
key_points: la novela = novel, el cuento = short story, el ensayo = essay, la poesía = poetry
la trama = plot, el personaje = character, el desenlace = ending/resolution
la metáfora = metaphor, la ironía = irony, el simbolismo = symbolism
analizar = analyze, interpretar = interpret, la corriente literaria = literary movement

vocab_list.example: La trama de la novela es muy compleja.
vocab_list.example_meaning: The plot of the novel is very complex.

vocab_list.example: El personaje principal evoluciona a lo largo de la historia.
vocab_list.example_meaning: The main character evolves throughout the story.

vocab_list.example: El poeta usa metáforas para expresar el dolor.
vocab_list.example_meaning: The poet uses metaphors to express pain.

vocab_list.example: El desenlace de la obra fue totalmente inesperado.
vocab_list.example_meaning: The ending of the work was completely unexpected.

ch_vocab_b2_04.title: Business & Marketing
ch_vocab_b2_04.theory:
## Business and Marketing Vocabulary

At the B2 level, you need vocabulary for discussing business strategy, marketing concepts, and corporate environments. This goes beyond basic work vocabulary into the language of commerce and entrepreneurship.

### Business Fundamentals
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **la empresa** | company / business |
| **el negocio** | business (venture) |
| **la sociedad** | corporation / partnership |
| **la sede** | headquarters |
| **la filial / la sucursal** | subsidiary / branch |
| **el/la socio/a** | partner / associate |
| **el/la emprendedor/a** | entrepreneur |
| **la pyme** | SME (small/medium enterprise) |

### Marketing and Sales
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **la marca** | brand |
| **la publicidad** | advertising |
| **el mercado** | market |
| **el consumidor** | consumer |
| **el público objetivo** | target audience |
| **la cuota de mercado** | market share |
| **el lanzamiento** | launch (of a product) |
| **la estrategia de ventas** | sales strategy |
| **el margen de beneficio** | profit margin |

### Business Verbs and Expressions
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **invertir** | to invest |
| **facturar** | to invoice / to bill |
| **cotizar en bolsa** | to be listed on the stock exchange |
| **ampliar el negocio** | to expand the business |
| **lanzar un producto** | to launch a product |
| **captar clientes** | to attract / acquire customers |
| **fidelizar clientes** | to build customer loyalty |
| **posicionarse en el mercado** | to position oneself in the market |

### Useful Expressions
- **La empresa facturó 10 millones de euros.** — The company invoiced 10 million euros.
- **Hay que captar nuevos clientes.** — We need to attract new customers.
- **El producto se posicionó como líder del mercado.** — The product positioned itself as the market leader.
- **Vamos a lanzar una campaña publicitaria.** — We are going to launch an advertising campaign.
- **La startup consiguió financiación de un inversor.** — The startup obtained funding from an investor.
key_points: la empresa = company, el negocio = business venture, la sede = headquarters
la marca = brand, el mercado = market, la cuota de mercado = market share
invertir = invest, facturar = invoice, lanzar un producto = launch a product
captar clientes = attract customers, fidelizar = build loyalty, el público objetivo = target audience

vocab_list.example: Esa marca es conocida en toda Latinoamérica.
vocab_list.example_meaning: That brand is well-known throughout Latin America.

vocab_list.example: Decidieron invertir en energías renovables.
vocab_list.example_meaning: They decided to invest in renewable energies.

vocab_list.example: El consumidor actual busca productos sostenibles.
vocab_list.example_meaning: Today's consumer looks for sustainable products.

vocab_list.example: La empresa lanzó un producto innovador al mercado.
vocab_list.example_meaning: The company launched an innovative product on the market.

ch_vocab_b2_05.title: Healthcare System
ch_vocab_b2_05.theory:
## Healthcare System Vocabulary

Understanding the healthcare system vocabulary is essential for navigating medical situations in Spanish-speaking countries. At the B2 level, you should know how to describe symptoms, understand medical procedures, and discuss healthcare policies.

### Healthcare Infrastructure
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **el sistema sanitario** | healthcare system |
| **la sanidad pública** | public healthcare |
| **la sanidad privada** | private healthcare |
| **el hospital** | hospital |
| **el centro de salud** | health center / clinic |
| **urgencias** | emergency room |
| **la consulta** | doctor's office / appointment |
| **la planta / el piso** | floor / ward |
| **la UCI (Unidad de Cuidados Intensivos)** | ICU |

### Medical Professionals
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **el/la médico/a de cabecera** | general practitioner (GP) |
| **el/la especialista** | specialist |
| **el/la cirujano/a** | surgeon |
| **el/la enfermero/a** | nurse |
| **el/la farmacéutico/a** | pharmacist |
| **el/la psicólogo/a** | psychologist |

### Medical Procedures and Terms
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **el diagnóstico** | diagnosis |
| **el tratamiento** | treatment |
| **la receta** | prescription |
| **el análisis de sangre** | blood test |
| **la radiografía** | X-ray |
| **la cirugía / la operación** | surgery / operation |
| **la vacuna** | vaccine |
| **el seguro médico** | health insurance |
| **la lista de espera** | waiting list |

### Medical Verbs
- **recetar** — to prescribe
- **operar** — to operate
- **ingresar (en el hospital)** — to be admitted (to the hospital)
- **dar de alta** — to discharge (from hospital)
- **pedir cita** — to make an appointment
- **hacerse un análisis** — to have a test done

### Useful Expressions
- **Me han derivado a un especialista.** — I've been referred to a specialist.
- **Tengo que pedir cita con el médico de cabecera.** — I need to make an appointment with my GP.
- **Le dieron de alta después de tres días.** — He was discharged after three days.
- **Estoy en lista de espera para una operación.** — I'm on the waiting list for an operation.
key_points: el sistema sanitario = healthcare system, la sanidad pública/privada = public/private healthcare
el médico de cabecera = GP, el especialista = specialist, el cirujano = surgeon
el diagnóstico = diagnosis, el tratamiento = treatment, la receta = prescription
ingresar = be admitted, dar de alta = discharge, pedir cita = make an appointment
la lista de espera = waiting list, el seguro médico = health insurance

vocab_list.example: Mi médico de cabecera me derivó a un especialista.
vocab_list.example_meaning: My GP referred me to a specialist.

vocab_list.example: El doctor me dio una receta para los antibióticos.
vocab_list.example_meaning: The doctor gave me a prescription for antibiotics.

vocab_list.example: Lo ingresaron en el hospital por una neumonía.
vocab_list.example_meaning: He was admitted to the hospital for pneumonia.

vocab_list.example: Llevo seis meses en la lista de espera para la operación.
vocab_list.example_meaning: I've been on the waiting list for the operation for six months.

ch_vocab_b2_06.title: Advanced Technologie
ch_vocab_b2_06.theory:
## Advanced Technology Vocabulary

### Core Technology Terms

|---|---|
| **la inteligencia artificial (IA)** | artificial intelligence (AI) |
| **el algoritmo** | algorithm |
| **la base de datos** | database |
| **la nube** | cloud (computing) |
| **el software / el programa** | software |
| **el hardware** | hardware |
| **la plataforma** | platform |
| **el servidor** | server |
| **la red** | network |

### Cybersecurity
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **la ciberseguridad** | cybersecurity |
| **el ciberataque** | cyberattack |
| **el pirata informático / el hacker** | hacker |
| **la contraseña** | password |
| **el cifrado / la encriptación** | encryption |
| **la brecha de seguridad** | security breach |
| **los datos personales** | personal data |
| **la privacidad** | privacy |

### Digital Transformation
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **la transformación digital** | digital transformation |
| **la automatización** | automation |
| **el aprendizaje automático** | machine learning |
| **los macrodatos / el big data** | big data |
| **el internet de las cosas (IoT)** | Internet of Things (IoT) |
| **la realidad virtual** | virtual reality |
| **la realidad aumentada** | augmented reality |

### Technology Verbs

- **desarrollar** — to develop
- **implementar** — to implement
- **actualizar** — to update
- **almacenar (en la nube)** — to store (in the cloud)

### Useful Expressions
- **Los datos se almacenan en la nube.** — The data is stored in the cloud.

- **La inteligencia artificial está transformando la industria.** — AI is transforming the industry.
- **Es imprescindible proteger los datos personales.** — It is essential to protect personal data.
key_points: la inteligencia artificial = AI, el algoritmo = algorithm, la nube = cloud

vocab_list.example: Todos nuestros archivos se almacenan en la nube.

vocab_list.example_meaning: They detected a security breach in the system.

ch_vocab_b2_07.title: Social Issues (Advanced)
ch_vocab_b2_07.theory:

|---|---|
| **la desigualdad** | inequality |
| **la pobreza** | poverty |
| **la brecha salarial** | wage gap |
| **la exclusión social** | social exclusion |
| **las personas sin hogar** | homeless people |
| **la marginación** | marginalization |
| **el umbral de pobreza** | poverty line |
| **la redistribución de la riqueza** | redistribution of wealth |

### Discrimination and Rights
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **la discriminación** | discrimination |
| **el racismo** | racism |
| **el machismo / el sexismo** | sexism |
| **la igualdad de género** | gender equality |
| **los derechos humanos** | human rights |
| **el acoso** | harassment |
| **la diversidad** | diversity |
| **la inclusión** | inclusion |

### Migration
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **la inmigración** | immigration |
| **el/la inmigrante** | immigrant |
| **el/la refugiado/a** | refugee |
| **el asilo político** | political asylum |

| **la frontera** | border |

### Social Action
| Spanish | English |

### Useful Expressions
- **La desigualdad social sigue siendo un problema grave.** — Social inequality remains a serious problem.
- **Miles de personas se manifestaron contra el racismo.** — Thousands of people demonstrated against racism.
- **Hay que sensibilizar a la sociedad sobre la diversidad.** — We need to raise society's awareness about diversity.
- **Los refugiados solicitaron asilo político.** — The refugees applied for political asylum.
key_points: la desigualdad = inequality, la pobreza = poverty, la brecha salarial = wage gap

vocab_list.example: La desigualdad económica ha aumentado en los últimos años.
vocab_list.example_meaning: Economic inequality has increased in recent years.

vocab_list.example: Toda persona tiene derechos humanos fundamentales.
vocab_list.example_meaning: Every person has fundamental human rights.

vocab_list.example: El país acogió a miles de refugiados del conflicto.

vocab_list.example: Los trabajadores se manifestaron por mejores condiciones laborales.
vocab_list.example_meaning: The workers demonstrated for better working conditions.

ch_vocab_b2_08.title: Idioms (Modismos)
ch_vocab_b2_08.theory:
## Spanish Idioms (Modismos)

Idioms are fixed expressions whose meaning cannot be deduced from the individual words. Mastering Spanish idioms is a hallmark of B2-level proficiency and makes your speech sound natural and fluent.

### Idioms with Body Parts
| Idiom | Literal Meaning | Actual Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| **no tener pelos en la lengua** | not to have hairs on the tongue | to be outspoken / blunt |
| **meter la pata** | to put the paw in | to put one's foot in it / to blunder |
| **costar un ojo de la cara** | to cost an eye from the face | to cost an arm and a leg |
| **estar hasta las narices** | to be up to the noses | to be fed up |
| **tener mala cara** | to have a bad face | to look unwell |
| **dar la espalda** | to give the back | to turn one's back on |

### Idioms with Animals
| Idiom | Literal Meaning | Actual Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| **ser un buitre** | to be a vulture | to be an opportunist |
| **llevarse como el perro y el gato** | to get along like dog and cat | to fight like cats and dogs |
| **tener memoria de pez** | to have the memory of a fish | to have a terrible memory |
| **ser pan comido** | to be eaten bread | to be a piece of cake |

### Everyday Idioms
| Idiom | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **ir al grano** | to get to the point |
| **echar una mano** | to give a hand / help |
| **dar en el clavo** | to hit the nail on the head |
| **estar en las nubes** | to have one's head in the clouds |
| **no dar abasto** | to not be able to keep up |
| **tomar el pelo (a alguien)** | to pull someone's leg |
| **tirar la toalla** | to throw in the towel |
| **ponerse las pilas** | to get one's act together |
| **dar la lata** | to be a nuisance / pest |
| **quedarse en blanco** | to go blank (mind) |

### Usage in Context
- **Voy a ir al grano: necesitamos más dinero.** — I'll get to the point: we need more money.
- **¿Me echas una mano con la mudanza?** — Can you give me a hand with the move?
- **El examen me costó un ojo de la cara en horas de estudio.** — The exam cost me a fortune in study hours.
- **Juan siempre mete la pata en las reuniones.** — Juan always puts his foot in it during meetings.
- **Estoy hasta las narices del ruido de las obras.** — I'm fed up with the construction noise.
key_points: meter la pata = to blunder, costar un ojo de la cara = to cost a fortune
ir al grano = get to the point, echar una mano = give a hand, dar en el clavo = hit the nail on the head
tomar el pelo = pull someone's leg, tirar la toalla = throw in the towel
ponerse las pilas = get one's act together, quedarse en blanco = go blank
estar hasta las narices = be fed up, no dar abasto = not keep up

vocab_list.meaning: to put one's foot in it / blunder
vocab_list.example: Metí la pata al mencionar su ex en la cena.
vocab_list.example_meaning: I put my foot in it by mentioning his ex at dinner.

vocab_list.example: Deja de dar rodeos y ve al grano.
vocab_list.example_meaning: Stop beating around the bush and get to the point.

vocab_list.example: ¿Me puedes echar una mano con este proyecto?
vocab_list.example_meaning: Can you give me a hand with this project?

vocab_list.example: Me quedé en blanco durante el examen oral.
vocab_list.example_meaning: My mind went blank during the oral exam.

ch_vocab_b2_09.title: Academic Language (Basics)
ch_vocab_b2_09.theory:
## Basic Academic Language

Academic Spanish is essential for university studies, research, and formal writing. At the B2 level, you should be familiar with the vocabulary used in essays, presentations, and academic discussions.

### Structuring an Essay or Presentation
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **la introducción** | introduction |
| **el desarrollo** | body / development |
| **la conclusión** | conclusion |
| **la tesis** | thesis |
| **la hipótesis** | hypothesis |
| **el argumento** | argument |
| **el párrafo** | paragraph |
| **la cita** | citation / quote |
| **la bibliografía** | bibliography |
| **la fuente** | source |

### Academic Verbs
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **investigar** | to research |
| **analizar** | to analyze |
| **argumentar** | to argue |
| **citar** | to cite / quote |
| **exponer** | to present / set forth |
| **sintetizar** | to synthesize |
| **contrastar** | to contrast |
| **demostrar** | to demonstrate |
| **evaluar** | to evaluate |
| **concluir** | to conclude |

### Linking Words for Academic Writing
**Adding ideas:**
- **además** — furthermore
- **asimismo** — likewise
- **por otra parte** — on the other hand

**Contrasting:**
- **sin embargo** — however
- **no obstante** — nevertheless
- **a pesar de (que)** — despite / in spite of

**Cause and effect:**
- **por lo tanto / por consiguiente** — therefore
- **debido a (que)** — due to
- **como consecuencia** — as a consequence

**Concluding:**
- **en conclusión** — in conclusion
- **en resumen** — in summary
- **en definitiva** — ultimately / in short

### Example Academic Sentences
- **En este ensayo se analizarán las causas de la desigualdad.** — This essay will analyze the causes of inequality.
- **Como se ha demostrado anteriormente...** — As has been demonstrated previously...
- **Los datos sugieren que la hipótesis es correcta.** — The data suggest that the hypothesis is correct.
- **En conclusión, es necesario adoptar medidas urgentes.** — In conclusion, it is necessary to adopt urgent measures.
key_points: la tesis = thesis, la hipótesis = hypothesis, la cita = citation, la fuente = source
investigar = research, analizar = analyze, sintetizar = synthesize, evaluar = evaluate
Key connectors: sin embargo (however), por lo tanto (therefore), debido a (due to)
en conclusión = in conclusion, en resumen = in summary, en definitiva = ultimately

vocab_list.example: La hipótesis del estudio fue confirmada por los resultados.
vocab_list.example_meaning: The study's hypothesis was confirmed by the results.

vocab_list.example: Los científicos investigan nuevas formas de energía limpia.
vocab_list.example_meaning: The scientists are researching new forms of clean energy.

vocab_list.example: Los resultados son prometedores; sin embargo, se necesitan más pruebas.
vocab_list.example_meaning: The results are promising; however, more tests are needed.

vocab_list.example: Es importante verificar la fiabilidad de las fuentes.
vocab_list.example_meaning: It is important to verify the reliability of the sources.

ch_vocab_b2_10.title: Debate & Argumentation
ch_vocab_b2_10.theory:
## Debate and Argumentation Vocabulary

At the B2 level, you should be able to participate in debates, present arguments, counter opposing views, and structure your reasoning persuasively. This vocabulary is essential for DELE B2 oral and written tasks.

### Presenting Your Position
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **en mi opinión / a mi juicio** | in my opinion |
| **desde mi punto de vista** | from my point of view |
| **considero que** | I consider that |
| **estoy convencido/a de que** | I am convinced that |
| **sostengo que** | I maintain that |
| **cabe destacar que** | it is worth noting that |
| **es evidente que** | it is evident that |

### Agreeing and Disagreeing
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **estoy de acuerdo (con)** | I agree (with) |
| **coincido contigo en que** | I agree with you that |
| **tienes razón en que** | you are right that |
| **discrepo / no estoy de acuerdo** | I disagree |
| **respeto tu opinión, pero** | I respect your opinion, but |
| **me temo que no comparto esa visión** | I'm afraid I don't share that view |

### Building Arguments
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **en primer lugar / en segundo lugar** | firstly / secondly |
| **por un lado... por otro (lado)** | on one hand... on the other hand |
| **a favor de / en contra de** | in favor of / against |
| **el argumento a favor** | the argument in favor |
| **el argumento en contra** | the argument against |
| **según los datos / las estadísticas** | according to the data / statistics |
| **los estudios demuestran que** | studies show that |

### Countering Arguments
- **Aunque es cierto que..., también hay que tener en cuenta que...** — While it's true that..., we also have to consider that...
- **Ese argumento no tiene en cuenta...** — That argument doesn't take into account...
- **Se podría argumentar lo contrario.** — One could argue the opposite.
- **Eso es una generalización.** — That is a generalization.

### Concluding a Debate
- **En definitiva...** — Ultimately...
- **Para concluir / En resumen...** — To conclude / In summary...
- **Todo lo anterior demuestra que...** — All of the above demonstrates that...
- **Queda claro que...** — It is clear that...
key_points: considero que = I consider that, estoy convencido de que = I'm convinced that, sostengo que = I maintain that
discrepo = I disagree, coincido contigo = I agree with you, cabe destacar que = it's worth noting that
por un lado... por otro = on one hand... on the other, a favor de / en contra de = for / against
aunque es cierto que... = while it's true that..., se podría argumentar lo contrario = one could argue the opposite

vocab_list.example: Considero que la educación es la clave del progreso.
vocab_list.example_meaning: I consider that education is the key to progress.

vocab_list.example: Discrepo de esa interpretación de los hechos.
vocab_list.example_meaning: I disagree with that interpretation of the facts.

vocab_list.example: Cabe destacar que los resultados no son definitivos.
vocab_list.example_meaning: It is worth noting that the results are not definitive.

vocab_list.meaning: on one hand... on the other
vocab_list.example: Por un lado es cómodo, pero por otro es caro.
vocab_list.example_meaning: On one hand it's convenient, but on the other it's expensive.

ch_vocab_b2_11.title: Nuances of Emotion
ch_vocab_b2_11.theory:
## Nuances of Emotion Vocabulary

At the B2 level, you move beyond basic emotions (happy, sad, angry) to express more nuanced and specific feelings. This vocabulary allows you to describe emotional states with precision, which is essential for personal narratives, literature, and deep conversations.

### Positive Emotions (Beyond "Happy")
| Spanish | English | Nuance |
|---|---|---|
| **entusiasmado/a** | enthusiastic / thrilled | excited about something specific |
| **eufórico/a** | euphoric | extreme joy |
| **agradecido/a** | grateful | thankful for something |
| **satisfecho/a** | satisfied | content with a result |
| **aliviado/a** | relieved | after worry or stress |
| **orgulloso/a** | proud | achievement-related |
| **ilusionado/a** | excited / hopeful | looking forward to something |
| **conmovido/a** | moved / touched | emotionally affected |

### Negative Emotions (Beyond "Sad")
| Spanish | English | Nuance |
|---|---|---|
| **angustiado/a** | anguished / distressed | deep anxiety |
| **agobiado/a** | overwhelmed | stressed by too much |
| **decepcionado/a** | disappointed | unmet expectations |
| **frustrado/a** | frustrated | blocked from a goal |
| **indignado/a** | outraged | moral anger |
| **desesperado/a** | desperate | loss of hope |
| **melancólico/a** | melancholic | bittersweet sadness |
| **nostálgico/a** | nostalgic | longing for the past |
| **resentido/a** | resentful | lingering bitterness |
| **avergonzado/a** | ashamed / embarrassed | shame about something |

### Complex / Mixed Emotions
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **ambivalente** | ambivalent |
| **perplejo/a** | perplexed / baffled |
| **abrumado/a** | overwhelmed (not necessarily negative) |
| **desconcertado/a** | bewildered / disconcerted |
| **receloso/a** | wary / suspicious |
| **escéptico/a** | skeptical |

### Expressing Emotions
- **Me siento agobiado por la cantidad de trabajo.** — I feel overwhelmed by the amount of work.
- **Estoy ilusionada con el viaje.** — I'm excited about the trip.
- **Se quedó perplejo ante la noticia.** — He was bewildered by the news.
- **La película me dejó conmovida.** — The film left me deeply moved.
- **Siento una profunda nostalgia por mi infancia.** — I feel a deep nostalgia for my childhood.

### Verbs for Emotional States
- **conmover** — to move (emotionally)
- **agobiar** — to overwhelm
- **decepcionar** — to disappoint
- **indignar** — to outrage
- **ilusionar** — to excite / give hope
key_points: ilusionado = excited/hopeful, conmovido = moved/touched, agradecido = grateful
agobiado = overwhelmed (stress), angustiado = anguished, decepcionado = disappointed
indignado = outraged (moral), frustrado = frustrated, melancólico = melancholic
perplejo = baffled, ambivalente = ambivalent, receloso = wary, escéptico = skeptical

vocab_list.example: Estoy agobiada con los plazos del trabajo.
vocab_list.example_meaning: I'm overwhelmed with the work deadlines.

vocab_list.example: Los niños están muy ilusionados con la Navidad.
vocab_list.example_meaning: The children are very excited about Christmas.

vocab_list.example: El discurso me dejó profundamente conmovido.
vocab_list.example_meaning: The speech left me deeply moved.

vocab_list.example: Los ciudadanos estaban indignados por la corrupción.
vocab_list.example_meaning: The citizens were outraged by the corruption.

ch_vocab_b2_12.title: Legal Terminology (Basics)
ch_vocab_b2_12.theory:
## Basic Legal Terminology

Even if you don't work in law, understanding basic legal vocabulary in Spanish is important for reading contracts, understanding your rights, and following news about legal proceedings. At the B2 level, you should know the most common terms.

### The Legal System
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **el derecho** | law (as a field) / right |
| **la ley** | law (specific statute) |
| **la justicia** | justice |
| **el tribunal** | court |
| **el juzgado** | courthouse / court |
| **la jurisdicción** | jurisdiction |
| **el código penal** | criminal code |
| **el código civil** | civil code |

### People in the Legal System
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **el/la juez/a** | judge |
| **el/la abogado/a** | lawyer |
| **el/la fiscal** | prosecutor |
| **el/la acusado/a** | defendant / accused |
| **la víctima** | victim |
| **el/la testigo** | witness |
| **el jurado** | jury |
| **el/la demandante** | plaintiff / claimant |

### Legal Proceedings
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **el juicio** | trial |
| **la demanda** | lawsuit / claim |
| **la denuncia** | formal complaint / report |
| **la sentencia** | sentence / verdict |
| **el recurso / la apelación** | appeal |
| **la fianza** | bail |
| **la prueba** | evidence |
| **la condena** | conviction / sentence |
| **la absolución** | acquittal |

### Legal Verbs
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **denunciar** | to report / file a complaint |
| **demandar** | to sue |
| **juzgar** | to judge / try |
| **condenar** | to convict / sentence |
| **absolver** | to acquit |
| **apelar / recurrir** | to appeal |
| **declarar culpable / inocente** | to find guilty / innocent |
| **infringir la ley** | to break the law |

### Useful Expressions
- **El acusado fue declarado inocente.** — The defendant was found innocent.
- **Presentaron una denuncia por fraude.** — They filed a complaint for fraud.
- **El juez dictó sentencia.** — The judge passed sentence.
- **La defensa presentó nuevas pruebas.** — The defense presented new evidence.
- **Tiene derecho a un abogado.** — You have the right to a lawyer.
key_points: el derecho = law (field)/right, la ley = specific law, el tribunal = court
el juez = judge, el abogado = lawyer, el fiscal = prosecutor, el acusado = defendant
el juicio = trial, la sentencia = verdict/sentence, la denuncia = formal complaint
denunciar = report, demandar = sue, condenar = convict, absolver = acquit
declarar culpable/inocente = find guilty/innocent, infringir la ley = break the law

vocab_list.example: La jueza dictó una sentencia de tres años de prisión.
vocab_list.example_meaning: The judge handed down a sentence of three years in prison.

vocab_list.example: Denunciaron el robo en la comisaría.
vocab_list.example_meaning: They reported the robbery at the police station.

vocab_list.example: La sentencia fue apelada por la defensa.
vocab_list.example_meaning: The verdict was appealed by the defense.

vocab_list.example: Las pruebas demostraron la inocencia del acusado.
vocab_list.example_meaning: The evidence proved the defendant's innocence.

ch_vocab_b2_13.title: Finance & Economy
ch_vocab_b2_13.theory:
## Finance and Economy Vocabulary

At the B2 level, understanding financial and economic terminology is crucial for following news, managing personal finances, and discussing economic policies in Spanish.

### Personal Finance
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **la cuenta bancaria** | bank account |
| **la cuenta corriente** | checking account |
| **la cuenta de ahorros** | savings account |
| **la hipoteca** | mortgage |
| **el préstamo** | loan |
| **la deuda** | debt |
| **los intereses** | interest |
| **la nómina** | payroll / paycheck |
| **el presupuesto** | budget |
| **los impuestos** | taxes |

### The Economy
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **la economía** | economy |
| **el PIB (Producto Interior Bruto)** | GDP |
| **la inflación** | inflation |
| **la recesión** | recession |
| **el crecimiento económico** | economic growth |
| **la tasa de desempleo** | unemployment rate |
| **el déficit** | deficit |
| **la deuda pública** | public debt |
| **el tipo de interés** | interest rate |

### Investment and Markets
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **la bolsa (de valores)** | stock market |
| **las acciones** | stocks / shares |
| **la inversión** | investment |
| **el/la inversor/a** | investor |
| **los fondos de inversión** | investment funds |
| **la rentabilidad** | profitability / return |
| **el riesgo** | risk |
| **la divisa** | currency (foreign) |
| **el tipo de cambio** | exchange rate |

### Financial Verbs
- **ahorrar** — to save (money)
- **invertir** — to invest
- **endeudarse** — to go into debt
- **cotizar** — to be quoted/listed (stock market)
- **recaudar** — to collect (taxes, funds)
- **presupuestar** — to budget
- **amortizar** — to pay off / amortize

### Useful Expressions
- **La inflación ha subido un 3% este trimestre.** — Inflation has risen 3% this quarter.
- **El tipo de interés ha bajado al 1,5%.** — The interest rate has dropped to 1.5%.
- **España entró en recesión durante la crisis.** — Spain entered recession during the crisis.
- **Necesito solicitar un préstamo hipotecario.** — I need to apply for a mortgage loan.
- **Es importante diversificar las inversiones.** — It is important to diversify investments.
key_points: la cuenta bancaria = bank account, la hipoteca = mortgage, el préstamo = loan, la deuda = debt
la inflación = inflation, la recesión = recession, el PIB = GDP, el déficit = deficit
la bolsa = stock market, las acciones = stocks, la rentabilidad = profitability
ahorrar = save, invertir = invest, endeudarse = go into debt, amortizar = pay off

vocab_list.example: Estamos pagando la hipoteca del piso durante treinta años.
vocab_list.example_meaning: We are paying the mortgage on the apartment for thirty years.

vocab_list.example: La inflación está afectando al precio de los alimentos.
vocab_list.example_meaning: Inflation is affecting the price of food.

vocab_list.example: Intento ahorrar el 20% de mi sueldo cada mes.
vocab_list.example_meaning: I try to save 20% of my salary every month.

vocab_list.example: Compró acciones de una empresa tecnológica.
vocab_list.example_meaning: He bought shares in a tech company.

ch_vocab_b2_14.title: Advertising & Media Language
ch_vocab_b2_14.theory:
## Advertising and Media Language

At the B2 level, you should be able to analyze and discuss advertising techniques, media formats, and the language used to persuade audiences. This vocabulary is vital for media literacy and critical thinking about the messages we receive daily.

### Media Types
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **los medios de comunicación** | media |
| **la prensa** | the press |
| **el periódico / el diario** | newspaper |
| **la revista** | magazine |
| **el telediario / el noticiero** | TV news |
| **la emisora de radio** | radio station |
| **las redes sociales** | social media |
| **el medio digital** | digital media |
| **el podcast** | podcast |

### Advertising Vocabulary
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **la publicidad** | advertising |
| **el anuncio / el spot** | advertisement / ad |
| **la campaña publicitaria** | advertising campaign |
| **el eslogan** | slogan |
| **el logotipo** | logo |
| **el patrocinador** | sponsor |
| **la audiencia** | audience |
| **el/la consumidor/a** | consumer |
| **el público objetivo** | target audience |
| **la cuña publicitaria** | radio ad |

### Persuasion and Manipulation
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **persuadir** | to persuade |
| **convencer** | to convince |
| **manipular** | to manipulate |
| **influir (en)** | to influence |
| **engañar** | to deceive |
| **exagerar** | to exaggerate |
| **seducir** | to seduce / attract |
| **la publicidad engañosa** | misleading advertising |
| **el mensaje subliminal** | subliminal message |

### Journalism Vocabulary
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **el/la periodista** | journalist |
| **la redacción** | editorial office / writing |
| **el titular** | headline |
| **la portada** | front page / cover |
| **la crónica** | chronicle / report |
| **la entrevista** | interview |
| **el reportaje** | feature report |
| **la fuente** | source |
| **las noticias falsas / los bulos** | fake news |
| **la libertad de prensa** | freedom of the press |

### Useful Expressions
- **La publicidad intenta influir en nuestras decisiones de compra.** — Advertising tries to influence our purchasing decisions.
- **El eslogan de la campaña se hizo viral.** — The campaign slogan went viral.
- **Hay que ser crítico con la información de las redes sociales.** — One must be critical of social media information.
- **Denunciaron la campaña por publicidad engañosa.** — They reported the campaign for misleading advertising.
- **Los titulares sensacionalistas distorsionan la realidad.** — Sensationalist headlines distort reality.
key_points: los medios de comunicación = media, la prensa = the press, las redes sociales = social media
la publicidad = advertising, el anuncio = ad, el eslogan = slogan, el patrocinador = sponsor
persuadir = persuade, convencer = convince, manipular = manipulate, influir = influence
el titular = headline, la portada = front page, las noticias falsas = fake news
la publicidad engañosa = misleading advertising, la libertad de prensa = freedom of the press

vocab_list.example: La publicidad en redes sociales es cada vez más personalizada.
vocab_list.example_meaning: Advertising on social media is increasingly personalized.

vocab_list.example: El titular del periódico llamó la atención de todos.
vocab_list.example_meaning: The newspaper headline caught everyone's attention.

vocab_list.example: La campaña intentó persuadir a los jóvenes para que votaran.
vocab_list.example_meaning: The campaign tried to persuade young people to vote.

vocab_list.example: Es difícil distinguir las noticias falsas de las reales.
vocab_list.example_meaning: It is difficult to distinguish fake news from real news.
